questions.stem: If \(y = A + Be^x\), then prove that \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - \frac{dy}{dx} = 0\), where \(A\) and \(B\) are constants.

hi.stem: यदि \(y = A + Be^x\) है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - \frac{dy}{dx} = 0\) जहाँ \(A\) तथा \(B\) अचर हैं ।

questions.stem: Solve the differential equation \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x^2 - 1}{y^2 + 1}\).

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x^2 - 1}{y^2 + 1}\) को हल कीजिए ।

questions.stem: Show that \(f(x) = |x|\) is continuous for all values of \(x\).

hi.stem: दर्शाइए कि \(f(x) = |x|\), \(x\) के सभी मानों पर संतत है ।

questions.stem: Given any two events A and B are such that \(P(A) = \frac{1}{2}\), \(P(B) = \frac{1}{4}\) and \(P(A \cap B) = \frac{1}{8}\), then find P(not A and not B).

hi.stem: दो दी गयी घटनाएँ A तथा B ऐसी हैं कि \(P(A) = \frac{1}{2}\), \(P(B) = \frac{1}{4}\) तथा \(P(A \cap B) = \frac{1}{8}\), तब P(A-नहीं और B-नहीं) को ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: If \(A = \{1, 2\}\) and \(B = \{3, 4, 5\}\), then find all number of relations from \(A\) to \(B\).
If \(y = A\cos\theta + B\sin\theta\), then prove that \(\frac{d^2y}{d\theta^2} = -y\)

hi.stem: यदि \(y = A\cos\theta + B\sin\theta\), तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(\frac{d^2y}{d\theta^2} = -y\)

questions.subtopic: Equation of a Line in Space
questions.stem: Find the Cartesian equation of a line which passes through point \((3, -2, -5)\) and parallel to the vector \((3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 2\hat{k})\).

hi.stem: बिन्दु \((3, -2, -5)\) से गुजरने वाली तथा सदिश \((3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 2\hat{k})\) के समान्तर रेखा का कार्तीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions._flag: The Hindi print is faded (the minus signs of the point and vector and the words 'के समान्तर रेखा का कार्तीय' are faint); signs taken from the clear English print.

questions.stem: Solve the differential equation \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^x \cos x\).

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^x \cos x\) को हल कीजिए ।

questions.stem: If \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}\) and \(\vec{c}\) are vectors and \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = 0\), then find the value of \((\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a})\).

hi.stem: यदि \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}\) तथा \(\vec{c}\) सदिश हैं और \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = 0\) है, तो \((\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a})\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: If \(R_1\) and \(R_2\) be two equivalence relations of a set A, then prove that \((R_1 \cap R_2)\) also be an equivalence relation on A.

hi.stem: यदि \(R_1\) तथा \(R_2\), समुच्चय A में दो तुल्यता संबंध हैं, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि \((R_1 \cap R_2)\) भी A में एक तुल्यता सम्बन्ध है ।

questions.stem: Find the value of \(\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2} \sin^2 x\, dx\).

hi.stem: \(\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2} \sin^2 x\, dx\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: There are two children in a family. It is known that there is at least one child is boy, then find the probability that both children are boy.

hi.stem: एक परिवार में दो बच्चे हैं । यह ज्ञात हो कि बच्चों में कम से कम एक बच्चा लड़का है, तो दोनों बच्चों के लड़का होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: Find the interval in which the given function \(f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 6\) is (i) Increasing (ii) Decreasing.

hi.stem: अन्तराल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें \(f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 6\) से प्रदत्त फलन \(f\) (i) वर्धमान है (ii) ह्रासमान है ।

questions.stem: If the matrix \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 2y & z \\ x & y & -z \\ x & -y & z \end{bmatrix}\), satisfies the equation \(AA' = I\), then find the values of \(x, y\) and \(z\).

hi.stem: यदि आव्यूह \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 2y & z \\ x & y & -z \\ x & -y & z \end{bmatrix}\), समीकरण \(AA' = I\) को संतुष्ट करता है, तो \(x, y\) तथा \(z\) के मानों को ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: Find the differential coefficient of \(y = x^{\cos x} + (\sin x)^x\) with respect to \(x\).

hi.stem: \(y = x^{\cos x} + (\sin x)^x\) का अवकल गुणांक \(x\) सापेक्ष ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions._flag: A rubber stamp crosses the exponent cos x in the English print; the Hindi print shows it clearly.

questions.stem: Find the shortest distance between the lines \(\vec{r} = (2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}) + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\) and \(\vec{r} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + \lambda(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k})\).

hi.stem: रेखाओं \(\vec{r} = (2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}) + \mu(3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\) और \(\vec{r} = \hat{i} + \hat{j} + \lambda(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k})\) के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.subtopic: Graphical Solution and the Feasible Region
questions.stem:
Find the minimum value of \(Z = 3x + y\) by the graphical method under the following constraints :
\(x + y \le 8, 3x + 5y \ge 0, x \ge 0, y \ge 0\)

hi.stem:
निम्नलिखित अवरोधों के अन्तर्गत \(Z = 3x + y\) का न्यूनतम मान आलेखीय विधि से ज्ञात कीजिए :
\(x + y \le 8, 3x + 5y \ge 0, x \ge 0, y \ge 0\)

questions._flag: A rubber stamp crosses the '+' of Z = 3x + y in the English print; the Hindi print shows it clearly. Both languages print the constraint as 3x + 5y ≥ 0.

questions.stem: If a function \(f : R \rightarrow \{x \in R : x \in (-1, 1)\}\) is defined as \(f(x) = \frac{x}{1 + |x|}, x \in R\), then prove that \(f\) is one-one and onto.

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(f : R \rightarrow \{x \in R : x \in (-1, 1)\}\) जहाँ \(f(x) = \frac{x}{1 + |x|}, x \in R\) द्वारा परिभाषित फलन एकैकी तथा आच्छादक है ।

questions.stem: Show that \((3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} - 4\hat{k})\), \((2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k})\) and \((\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k})\) are the position vectors of vertices of a right angle triangle.

hi.stem: दिखाइए कि \((3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} - 4\hat{k})\), \((2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k})\) तथा \((\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k})\) एक समकोण त्रिभुज के शीर्षों के स्थिति सदिश हैं ।

questions._flag: The languages differ: the English prints the second vector as (2i − j − k) and the Hindi as (2i − j + k); each transcribed as printed. A stamp covers the sign before j in the English, read as − from the Hindi.

questions.subtopic: Derivatives of Implicit and Inverse Trigonometric Functions
questions.stem: If \(x\sqrt{1 + y} + y\sqrt{1 + x} = 0, -1 < x < 1\), then prove that \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{1}{(1 + x)^2}\)

hi.stem: यदि \(x\sqrt{1 + y} + y\sqrt{1 + x} = 0, -1 < x < 1\) है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{1}{(1 + x)^2}\)

questions.stem: There are 10 white and 5 black balls in a bag. Two balls are drawn one by one. First ball is not placed back before the second is taken out. Assume that the taking out of each ball from the bag is equally likely. What is the probability that both balls taken out are white ?

hi.stem: एक थैले में 10 सफेद तथा 5 काली गेंदें हैं । दो गेंद एक के बाद एक निकाली जाती हैं और पहली गेंद दूसरी को निकालने से पहले वापस नहीं रखी जाती है । मान लीजिए कि थैले में से प्रत्येक गेंद का निकालना समसंभाव्य है, तो दोनों सफेद गेंद निकालने की क्या प्रायिकता है ?

questions._flag: A rubber stamp crosses 'सफेद' in the last Hindi line; the reading matches the English 'white'.

questions.stem: Prove that \(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| \le |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\) is always true for any two vectors \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\).

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि दो सदिशों \(\vec{a}\) और \(\vec{b}\) के लिए सदैव \(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| \le |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\) होता है ।

questions.subtopic: Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix
questions.stem: If \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 3 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & 1 \\ 4 & 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), then verify that \(A(\text{adj } A) = |A|I\) and find \(A^{-1}\).

hi.stem: यदि \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 3 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & 1 \\ 4 & 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), तो सत्यापित कीजिए कि \(A(\text{adj } A) = |A|I\) और \(A^{-1}\) ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions._flag: The Hindi print's '=' and the '−1' of A^{-1} are faded; read from the clear English print.

questions.stem:
Solve the system of equations
\(x + y + z = 2,\)
\(2x + y - 3z = 0\)
\(x - y + z - 4 = 0\) by matrix method.

hi.stem:
समीकरण निकाय
\(x + y + z = 2,\)
\(2x + y - 3z = 0\)
\(x - y + z - 4 = 0\) को आव्यूह विधि से हल कीजिए ।

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए : \(\int_0^{\pi/4} \log_e(1 + \tan\theta)\, d\theta = \frac{\pi}{8}\log_e 2\)
